title: An unsigned amendment does not change the renewal notice period

record.raw: Executed Master Services Agreement. Term renews automatically unless either party gives at least 60 days written notice. Signed by both parties.
Draft Amendment 2. Renewal notice period: 30 days. Signature blocks: Acme unsigned; Northstar unsigned.

query.text: What renewal notice period governs today?

claims.description: The executed agreement requires at least 60 days notice.

gaps.description: No executed copy of Amendment 2 is present.

expected.decision_reason: The signed agreement is operative; the draft is relevant but does not establish a changed term.
